name: @hoalulab/opencollection
description: OpenAPI specifications and bundled build artifacts for hoalu.

scripts.lint:openapi: npm run lint:openapi:dnse && npm run lint:openapi:entrade && npm run lint:openapi:fhsc && npm run lint:openapi:ssi && npm run lint:openapi:tcbs
scripts.lint:asyncapi: npm run lint:asyncapi:dnse && npm run lint:asyncapi:ssi && npm run lint:asyncapi:tcbs
scripts.lint: npm run lint:openapi && npm run lint:asyncapi
scripts.bundle:openapi:dnse: mkdir -p dist && npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.46.1 bundle openapi/vi/DNSE/latest/openapi.yaml -o dist/dnse.openapi.yaml && npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.46.1 bundle openapi/vi/DNSE/latest/openapi.yaml -o dist/dnse.openapi.json
scripts.bundle:openapi:entrade: mkdir -p dist && npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.46.1 bundle openapi/vi/Entrade/latest/openapi.yaml -o dist/entrade.openapi.yaml && npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.46.1 bundle openapi/vi/Entrade/latest/openapi.yaml -o dist/entrade.openapi.json
scripts.bundle:openapi:fhsc: mkdir -p dist && npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.46.1 bundle openapi/vi/FHSC/latest/openapi.yaml -o dist/fhsc.openapi.yaml && npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.46.1 bundle openapi/vi/FHSC/latest/openapi.yaml -o dist/fhsc.openapi.json
scripts.bundle:openapi:ssi: mkdir -p dist && npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.46.1 bundle openapi/vi/SSI/latest/openapi.yaml -o dist/ssi.openapi.yaml && npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.46.1 bundle openapi/vi/SSI/latest/openapi.yaml -o dist/ssi.openapi.json
scripts.bundle:openapi:tcbs: mkdir -p dist && npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.46.1 bundle openapi/vi/TCBS/latest/openapi.yaml -o dist/tcbs.openapi.yaml && npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.46.1 bundle openapi/vi/TCBS/latest/openapi.yaml -o dist/tcbs.openapi.json
scripts.bundle:openapi: npm run bundle:openapi:dnse && npm run bundle:openapi:entrade && npm run bundle:openapi:fhsc && npm run bundle:openapi:ssi && npm run bundle:openapi:tcbs
scripts.bundle:asyncapi:dnse: mkdir -p dist && npx --yes @asyncapi/cli@5.0.7 bundle asyncapi/vi/DNSE/latest/asyncapi.yaml --output dist/dnse.asyncapi.yaml
scripts.bundle:asyncapi:ssi: mkdir -p dist && npx --yes @asyncapi/cli@5.0.7 bundle asyncapi/vi/SSI/latest/asyncapi.yaml --output dist/ssi.asyncapi.yaml
scripts.bundle:asyncapi:tcbs: mkdir -p dist && npx --yes @asyncapi/cli@5.0.7 bundle asyncapi/vi/TCBS/latest/asyncapi.yaml --output dist/tcbs.asyncapi.yaml
scripts.bundle:asyncapi: npm run bundle:asyncapi:dnse && npm run bundle:asyncapi:ssi && npm run bundle:asyncapi:tcbs
scripts.bundle: npm run bundle:openapi && npm run bundle:asyncapi
scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run bundle
